scope: Reviewed-format opening records, source provenance, immutable snapshots and historical-only presentation; not live rule conversion or a model adaptation agent

validation.finalCopyRevision: Preparation says read, not saved; rebuilt and verified on deployed pages without rerunning unchanged complete suites

samples.supportedField: player credits from reviewed JSON initializer
protagonist money from reviewed YAML initializer

limitations: Only reviewed active template fingerprints and fixed public player fields are supported; changed or disabled templates stop adaptation
Opening records are historical declarations, not current balances, spendable assets or continuing update rules
No third-party scripts execute; nested inventories, arbitrary formulas, unrelated fields and unsupported formats are not converted
Native conflicts are detected for recognized initializer markers, not all semantic conflicts in arbitrary scripts or worldbooks
Old stories are not silently backfilled; real model quality and human acceptance remain open
EXP-02, EXP-ADAPT, EXP-06 and EXP-07D remain open
